text:
What happens in the process of nuclear fission?
A
Electrons are added to a nucleus.
B
Electrons are removed from a nucleus.
C
The nucleus of an atom splits.
D
Two atomic nuclei join together.

options.label: A
options.text: Electrons are added to a nucleus.

options.text: Electrons are removed from a nucleus.

options.label: C
